searchText: There seem to be 2 breaking differences between Prysm's and Lighthouse's JSON representations of blocks (such as in `/eth/v2/validator/blocks`): - Empty `extra_data` is "0x" in Lighthouse, but "" in Prysm (as <@144468805697929216> noted before) - `base_fee_per_gas` is decimal in Lighthouse, but hexadecimal in Prysm Since both seem to break cross-client validation (Prysm BN <-> Lighthouse VC), and the Beacon API spec seems to align with Lighthouse, I guess Prysm should adapt to the spec here? (i'm working on a Prysm PR now at https://github.com/moshe-blox/prysm/commit/95d317a740eb6adc47977b70939358636a394ced just wanna make sure it's the right call) cc <@308223150725005322> we're using hex for base_fee_per_gas in teku, havne't found extra_data yet will dig in a bit actually, we're decoding to allow either/or, but we serialize to hex string `base_fee_per_gas` has type `uint256`. As such, I would assume that we would serialize it in the same way that we serialize other numbers _i.e._ as a quoted integer rather than a hex string.

excerpts.content:
There seem to be 2 breaking differences between Prysm's and Lighthouse's JSON representations of blocks (such as in `/eth/v2/validator/blocks`):

- Empty `extra_data` is "0x" in Lighthouse, but "" in Prysm (as <@144468805697929216> noted before)
- `base_fee_per_gas` is decimal in Lighthouse, but hexadecimal in Prysm

Since both seem to break cross-client validation (Prysm BN <-> Lighthouse VC), and the Beacon API spec seems to align with Lighthouse, I guess Prysm should adapt to the spec here?

(i'm working on a Prysm PR now at https://github.com/moshe-blox/prysm/commit/95d317a740eb6adc47977b70939358636a394ced
just wanna make sure it's the right call)
